title: Molar energy of photons
statement:
An individual photon carries $[$e]\times10^{-19}$ J. Find the energy in kJ per mole of photons using $N_A=6.022\times10^{23}\ \mathrm{mol^{-1}}$.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Divide by 1000 because the answer is in kJ/mol.

hints: Convert from one photon to a mole.
Divide by 1000 because the answer is in kJ/mol.
solution: Multiply $[$e]\times10^{-19}$ J by $6.022\times10^{23}$ photons/mol, then divide by $1000$ to get kJ/mol.
